query: Which upstream shocks (weather, port closures, power outages) plausibly satisfy instrument relevance and exclusion for supplier shocks, and which first-stage F-stat, overidentification, and falsification tests will we pre-specify?

response.query: Which upstream shocks (weather, port closures, power outages) plausibly satisfy instrument relevance and exclusion for supplier shocks, and which first-stage F-stat, overidentification, and falsification tests will we pre-specify?
response.answer: Weather shocks, port closures, and power outages plausibly satisfy instrument relevance and exclusion. We will pre-specify a first-stage F-stat above 10, overidentification tests using the Hansen J statistic, and falsification tests on unrelated outcomes.
